profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Air Products

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop features, enhancements, and defect resolution according to business specifications.

Provide on-call incident resolution on a rotational basis.

Technologies include React, Redux, C# and SQL; Deployed into AWS architecture.

positions.title: Software Engineer - IT CDP
positions.description:
Build applications according to business needs using Reactjs, SQL, and C# from the ground up

Build backend infrastructure to provide data to POC. Including migrating data, utilizing stored procedures

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description:
Collaborated in a team to develop a web app to hold and generate reports on employee data using ASP.NET, Azure, Visual Studio and SQL Server Management Studio.

Designed and developed cloud-hosted (Azure) web app solution as an interim application portfolio to allow reporting and CRUD operations on extensive detailed list of applications owned by organization. Project incorporates ASP.NET/C#, JavaScript, SQL/stored procedures, and responsive Bootstrap.

Provided support for Daily Message site including implementing new features, bug fixes, and access control.

Enhanced Daily Message website according to executive requirements using JavaScript and Bootstrap, to be seen daily by entire network

positions.title: IT Consumer Technology Intern
positions.description:
Provided login validation and support for newly acquired staff in multiple St. Luke’s campuses

Validated data being transferred from previous systems to Epic Production

positions.title: US IT Applications Intern
positions.description:
Collaborated with Innovation, Business, and Mobile teams to develop and implement an application with authentication and enabled cross platform use via Unity and C#

Strategized with IT Infrastructure and Microsoft teams to design a solution using PowerShell scripts to automate application upload to Microsoft Intune

Automated API tests using Postman and Newman CLI

Supported and enhanced internal navigation web app, ensuring cross platform compatibility

Hosted virtual and personal meetings to gather system-specific dataflow information to create diagrams with Visio

Researched and documented the internal mobile application development process

positions.title: Account Analyst
positions.description:
Support up to 50 customers weekly at a Verizon Wireless premium retailer.

Troubleshoot issues including phones not powering on, calls disconnecting, and apps crashing during client use.

Provide exceptional customer service by exploring best plan options to reduce cost for the customer.

projects.title: Application Development Studio I
projects.description:
Created a hotel booking desktop Java application using MVC architecture. 

Project included a full proposal, design, unit testing and implementation phases.

projects.title: Mobile Development
projects.description:
Designed and developed an iOS mobile application using Swift with the purpose of tracking to-do activities entered by the user.

Created a client proposal, wireframe, flowchart, and conceptual models.

Presented proposal and the final working model of application to instructor and class.
